messages:
Maria (partnerships): quick heads-up — we're about to change the SDK auth header semantics (removing legacy `X-Redwood-Token` fallback). Need to map impact across marketplace vendors, HW SIs, and any joint beta partners. Can we do a quick compatibility gap analysis + hotfix gate plan?
Tom (sdk-engineering): noted. do we have exact date for the cutoff?
Maria (partnerships): tentative: 2026-05-12 start of staged enforcement, full enforcement 2026-06-09. want to keep 4 weeks for partner migration.
Jess (product): 4 weeks seems tight for some SI integrations. recommend opt-in canary for 2 weeks before enforcement + a rollback flag.
Kevin (eng-integrations): adding: we should produce a compatibility matrix: SDK versions affected, server-side token parsing, marketplace connector versions, and any vendor binaries that embed SDK. I'll draft.
Alexa (hw-partner): thanks — on our side we embed the SDK into device firmware. firmware cadence is monthly; we can land a shim in next OTA if we get clear changelog this week. firmware release candidate is 2026-05-05.
Tom (sdk-engineering): propose mitigations: 1) server-side accept both headers for the canary window, 2) publish SDK patch that logs a deprecation warning but keeps legacy behavior for 30 days, 3) compatibility test harness for partners.
Maria (partnerships): please outline communications: public changelog, private partner notice, marketplace vendor email, and a page in Partner Portal with migration steps + quick CLI.
Sam (legal): make sure partner SLAs are considered — any enforcement that causes downtime could trigger credits. we need opt-in notices and explicit timelines in contract addenda for enterprise partners.
Jess (product): also timeline for joint announcements: if a partner needs to align marketing, they need ~3 weeks lead time. so don't announce until stabilization window is passed.
Kevin (eng-integrations): I'll start the compatibility matrix doc. initial columns: partner, integration type (cloud-marketplace/hw/SI), SDK version in use, token header behavior, deploy cadence, blocker?
Tom (sdk-engineering): creating SDK patch: `v3.2.5` — will log `DeprecationWarning: X-Redwood-Token` and include env `RW_LEGACY_TOKEN_FALLBACK=true` for emergency. Plan to remove fallback in `v4.0.0` enforcement.
Alexa (hw-partner): can we get sample patches for firmware folks? they need C header snippets and unit tests.
Tom (sdk-engineering): yes, will add `auth_fallback.c` snippet and a tiny test harness.
Maria (partnerships): partner comms owner? @Alexa — you'll coordinate vendor notices for your HW integrators?
Alexa (hw-partner): yes, I'll send the vendor notice once we get the migration doc.
Maria (partnerships): marketplace owners? who will ping marketplace vendors and update Marketplace listing notes?
Jess (product): I can do marketplace listing update and the public changelog. suggest we lock wording by 2026-04-28.
Kevin (eng-integrations): question: do SIs require signed SDK binaries? some do, that affects hotfix cadence.
Tom (sdk-engineering): we sign official builds. we'll produce signed patch builds and a verified checksum list.
Sam (legal): include a short IP note for partners that embed SDK binaries about redistribution rights — avoids surprises.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary window open: 2026-05-01T10:00Z — will report errors to #eng-oncall.
Maria (partnerships): next steps: 1) Kevin to open compatibility matrix by EOD, 2) Tom to publish `v3.2.5` patch + firmware snippets by 2026-04-26, 3) Jess to draft marketplace + public changelog by 2026-04-28, 4) Sam to review partner notices and contract language by 2026-04-30, 5) partners to confirm migration plans by 2026-05-03.
Tom (sdk-engineering): I'll also prepare a small test script partners can run: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` vs `-H "X-Redwood-Token: <token>"` to show differences.
Alexa (hw-partner): ack — will circulate to device firmware leads and confirm by 2026-05-02.
Kevin (eng-integrations): adding risk: some SI pipelines pin SDK minor versions. we should provide a compatibility shim package via pip/npm that is explicit and temporary.
Jess (product): agree. also create a one-pager migration checklist for partner success.
Maria (partnerships): thanks all. I'll consolidate action items and send a private partner notice draft for review tomorrow. please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm your deliverable.
Tom (sdk-engineering): :thumbsup:
Kevin (eng-integrations): :thumbsup:
Alexa (hw-partner): :thumbsup:
Jess (product): :thumbsup:
Sam (legal): :thumbsup:
